Rule.name: DKN_Portal JDBC Provision
Rule.Description: Provisioning rule for the DKN_Portal JDBC application. Create inserts a new row in portal_users with status ENABLED. Disable sets status to DISABLED. Enable sets status back to ENABLED. Delete removes the row (added Day 5 to clean up accounts created in error). Any other operation fails with a clear error so nothing happens silently. Uses prepared statements so HR data can never be run as SQL.
